newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PLOCK RAISES PETROL, LOWERS DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PLOCK RAISES PETROL, LOWERS DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Poland's biggest Plock oil refinery raised on Monday by two percent prices of two types of petrol and lowered by less than one percent the price of diesel fuel, Plock spokeswoman said.
"We are raising the 94-octane leaded and 95-octane unleaded fuel by three groszes per litre and lowering our diesel price by one grosz," Romana Kuffel told Reuters.
The new price of the 94-octane leaded petrol is now 1.68 zlotys, the 95-octance unleaded 1.64 zlotys and diesel price 1.37 zlotys.
